category_edits.rationale: Test whether pooling the two most recent observed states reduces smoothing across older interests. Retain the 0.8 current-state/0.2 pooled-state blend, padding-aware normalization, causal backbone and final-real-position readout across all four category models.

change_summary: Shorten causal readout pooling from four states to two and synchronize checkpoint metadata and embedded predictor compatibility checks.
